profile_text: As a leading provider of human resources solutions, this recruitment and staffing agency has experienced rapid growth of 180.0% since its baseline, driven by its ability to deliver tailored recruitment services to businesses across various industries. With a focus on meeting the diverse staffing needs of its clients, the company has expanded its operations to support a workforce of 210 employees in 2024. This growth has earned it a "Gazelle" category designation, recognizing its exceptional expansion and success in the administrative and support service activities sector.
